Addressed Issues in May 2025

ID
Description
DIT-54573
Enterprise DLP fails to block a file containing sensitive data uploaded to LinkedIn Messenger that it successfully blocks for other supported apps.
Workaround: Install dynamic content version 8978-9450 or later.
